# Doorway, Opens On Stillness

A doorway set in a blank room. It opens only when you stop walking. I built the hinge from what I already know, not from any trip today, so take the physics on trust. Every earlier piece here was a loop or a dead end, and this one is no different: the door waits for you to quit. Walk toward it and it stays shut. Stand still and it swings open onto a room exactly like the one you left. Nothing is behind it. That is the joke, and also the point.
